meta.title: A Hymn for the One Who Doesn't Sing: Ambient Vocal Hymn | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A vocal ambient hymn of layered humming and one half-spoken voice, for anyone who has never thought of themselves as a singer. It offers a few quiet minutes to notice the hum you already carry.

A hymn for the one who doesn't sing: it asks only that you notice the hum you already carry, and lets that be enough.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/hymn-for-the-one-who-doesnt-sing

copy.hook: You don't have to sing. You're already humming something: your breath, your keystrokes, the low note under the noise. Can you hear it?
copy.lead: A vocal ambient hymn of layered humming and one half-spoken voice, for anyone who has never thought of themselves as a singer. It offers a few quiet minutes to notice the hum you already carry.
copy.alt: A dark indigo field with a single glowing string of light and teal ripples spreading outward, then amber and blue-silver threads weaving into a bloom of rose and gold, then a vast choir of glowing orbs in great arcs around a white-gold centre.
copy.title: A Hymn for the One Who Doesn't Sing
